camel_example: aliyun esa ListPostpaidRatePlanInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --UnrelatedType bot --PageSize 12 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-dps-xxxxxx' --SortBy CreateTime --ResourceOwner 1 --SortOrder desc --CheckRemainingSiteQuota true
description_en: Queries the list of pay-as-you-go plan instances
description_zh: 查询后付费套餐实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-postpaid-rate-plan-instances --check-remaining-site-quota true --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 12 --status online --instance-id sp-dps-xxxxxx --unrelated-type bot --resource-owner 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPostpaidRatePlanInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check for remaining site quota. Valid values:

true: Queries instances that have remaining site quota.

false: Does not filter by this condition
parameters.help_zh:
检查是否有剩余站点配额。取值范围:

true: 查询有剩余站点配额的实例

false: 不进行此条件筛选
parameters.name: check_remaining_site_quota

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort results. Valid values:

CreateTime: sorted by creation time
parameters.help_zh:
按哪个字段排序。取值:

CreateTime: 按创建时间排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

asc: ascending order

desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值:

asc: 升序

desc: 降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

online: Normal.

overdue: Overdue payment.

disable: Released
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值:

online: 正常使用状态

overdue: 已欠费

disable: 已释放
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Use this parameter to query a specific instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，用于精确查找单个实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instance has purchased additional bot or DDoS protection
parameters.name: unrelated_type

items.description_en: The details of a plan instance

BillingMethod.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
dps_month95: Monthly 95th Percentile
BillingMethod.description_zh:
计费方式。取值：
dps_month95：月95计费

BillingMode.description_en:
The billing mode. Valid values:

POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go
BillingMode.description_zh:
计费模式。取值:

POSTPAY: 后付费

Coverages.description_en:
The acceleration regions to which the instance can bindable sites. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

domestic: The Chinese mainland.
overseas: Global (excluding the Chinese mainland).
global: Global (including the Chinese mainland)
Coverages.description_zh:
该实例可绑定的站点的加速区域范围，多个用（,）隔开。取值：

domestic：国内。
overseas：全球（不包含国内）。
global：全球（包含国内）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ExpectedUpdateTime.description_en: The scheduled specification change time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ExpectedUpdateTime.description_zh: 预约变配时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PlanName.description_en: The English name of the plan

PlanNameCn.description_en: The Chinese name of the plan

PlanType.description_en:
The plan type of the instance. Valid values:
normal: Fixed edition plan.
enterprise: Enterprise edition plan
PlanType.description_zh:
套餐实例对应的套餐类型，取值：
normal：固定版套餐。
enterprise：企业版套餐

items.description_en: The list of sites that are associated with the current plan instance
items.description_zh: 已经绑定到当前套餐实例下的站点列表

SiteStatus.description_en:
The site status. Valid values:

pending: The site is pending configuration.
active: The site is activated.
offline: The site is offline.
moved: The site has been superseded
SiteStatus.description_zh:
站点状态。取值：

pending：站点待配置。
active：站点已激活。
offline：站点已下线。
moved：站点已被顶替

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
